represent a point in 2D space\nstruct Point {\n    double x, y;\n};\n\n// Structure to represent a cluster\nstruct Cluster {\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    int seed_point;\n};\n\n// Generate synthetic 2D point data in clusters\nvoid generateSyntheticData(std::vector<Point>& points, const int N, unsigned int seed = 42) {\n    auto frand = [&seed]() mutable { return rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX); };\n    \n    const double min_dim = std::min(MAX_WIDTH, MAX_HEIGHT);\n    int count = 0;\n    \n    while (count < N) {\n        // Create group_cnt points within a circle of radius R\n        // around center point (cntr_x, cntr_y)\n        const double cntr_x = frand() * MAX_WIDTH;\n        const double cntr_y = frand() * MAX_HEIGHT;\n        const double R = frand() * min_dim / 2.0;\n        int group_cnt = static_cast<int>(frand() * (N / 30.0));\n        \n        // Make sure we don't make more points than we need\n        if (group_cnt > (N - count)) {\n            group_cnt = N - count;\n        }\n        \n        while (group_cnt > 0) {\n            const double sign = (frand() < 0.5) ? -1.0 : 1.0;\n            const double r = frand() * R;\n            const double dx = (2.0 * frand() - 1.0) * r;\n            const double dy = std::sqrt(r * r - dx * dx) * sign;\n            const double x = cntr_x + dx;\n            const double y = cntr_y + dy;\n            \n            if (x < 0 || x > MAX_WIDTH || y < 0 || y > MAX_HEIGHT) {\n                continue;\n            }\n            \n            points[count] = {x, y};\n            count++;\n            group_cnt--;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Calculate Euclidean distance between two points\ninline double distance(const Point& p1, const Point& p2) {\n    double dx = p1.x - p2.x;\n    double dy = p1.y - p2.y;\n    return std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n}\n\n// Find the closest unclustered point to the current cluster that maintains diameter < threshold\n// Returns -1 if no such point exists\nint findClosestPoint(const std::vector<int>& cluster_members,\n                     const std::vector<bool>& clustered,\n                     const std::vector<bool>& in_cluster,\n                     const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                     const double threshold,\n                     const int point_count) {\n    int closest_point = -1;\n    double min_diameter = std::numeric_limits<double>::max();\n    \n    // Try each unclustered point as a candidate\n    for (int candidate = 0; candidate < point_count; ++candidate) {\n        // Skip if already clustered or already in this cluster\n        if (clustered[candidate] || in_cluster[candidate]) continue;\n        \n        // Calculate the maximum distance from candidate to all cluster members\n        double max_dist = 0.0;\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < cluster_members.size(); ++i) {\n            const int member = cluster_members[i];\n            const double dist = distance(points[candidate], points[member]);\n            max_dist = std::max(max_dist, dist);\n        }\n        \n        // If adding this point keeps diameter below threshold and is better than current best\n        if (max_dist < threshold && max_dist < min_diameter) {\n            min_diameter = max_dist;\n            closest_point = candidate;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    return closest_point;\n}\n\n// Generate a candidate cluster starting from a seed point\n// Returns the cardinality (size) of the cluster\nint generateCandidateCluster(const int seed_point,\n                              const std::vector<bool>& clustered,\n                              const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                              const double threshold,\n                              const int point_count,\n                              std::vector<int>* cluster_members = nullptr) {\n    std::vector<bool> in_cluster(point_count, false);\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    \n    // Add seed point\n    in_cluster[seed_point] = true;\n    members.push_back(seed_point);\n    \n    // Iteratively add closest points\n    while (static_cast<int>(members.size()) < point_count) {\n        // Find closest point to current cluster that maintains diameter < threshold\n        const int closest = findClosestPoint(members, clustered, in_cluster, points, \n                                             threshold, point_count);\n        \n        if (closest < 0) break; // No more points can be added\n        \n        in_cluster[closest] = true;\n        members.push_back(closest);\n    }\n    \n    // Copy members if requested\n    if (cluster_members) {\n        *cluster_members = members;\n    }\n    \n    return static_cast<int>(members.size());\n}\n\n// Main QT clustering algorithm\nstd::vector<Cluster> qtClustering(const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                                  const double threshold) {\n    const int N = static_cast<int>(points.size());\n    std::vector<bool> clustered(N, false);\n    std::vector<int> unclustered_indices;\n    std::vector<Cluster> clusters;\n    \n    // Initialize unclustered indices\n    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        unclustered_indices.push_back(i);\n    }\n    \n    // Main clustering loop\n    while (!unclustered_indices.empty()) {\n        int max_cardinality = -1;\n        int best_seed = -1;\n        std::vector<int> best_cluster_members;\n        \n        // Try each unclustered point as a seed\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < unclustered_indices.size(); ++i) {\n            const int seed = unclustered_indices[i];\n            if (clustered[seed]) continue;\n            \n            std::vector<int> candidate_members;\n            const int cardinality = generateCandidateCluster(seed, clustered, points, \n                                                       threshold, N, \n                                                       &candidate_members);\n            \n            if (cardinality > max_cardinality) {\n                max_cardinality = cardinality;\n                best_seed = seed;\n                best_cluster_members = candidate_members;\n            }\n        }\n        \n        // If we found a cluster, add it\n        if (best_seed >= 0 && max_cardinality > 0) {\n            Cluster cluster;\n            cluster.seed_point = best_seed;\n            cluster.members = best_cluster_members;\n            clusters.push_back(cluster);\n            \n            // Mark all members as clustered\n            for (size_t i = 0; i < best_cluster_members.size(); ++i) {\n                clustered[best_cluster_members[i]] = true;\n            }\n            \n            // Remove clustered points from unclustered list\n            unclustered_indices.erase(\n                std::remove_if(unclustered_indices.begin(), unclustered_indices.end(),\n                              [&clustered](int idx) { return clustered[idx]; }),\n cluster.members.size(); ++i) {\n            for (size_t j = i + 1; j < cluster.members.size(); ++j) {\n                const double dist = distance(points[cluster.members[i]], \n                                           points[cluster.members[j]]);\n                max_diameter = std::max(max_diameter, dist);\n            }\n        }\n        \n        if (c < 10) { // Print first 10 clusters\n            printf(\"  Cluster %zu: size=%zu, seed=%d, diameter=%.4f\\n\", \n                   c, cluster.members.size(), cluster.seed_point, max_diameter);\n        }\n        \n        // Validate diameter is within threshold\n        if (max_diameter > threshold * 1.001) { // Allow small numerical error\n            printf(\"ERROR: Cluster %zu has diameter %.4f > threshold %.4f\\n\", \n clustered_count, points.size() - clustered_count);\n    \n    return valid;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Number of points (default: 1000)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -t <float>   Distance threshold for clustering (default: 2.0)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    int num_points = 1000;\n    double threshold = 2.0;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n    \n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            num_points = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-t\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            threshold = atof(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    if (num_points <= 0 || threshold <= 0.0) {\n        printf(\"Error: Invalid parameters (num_points=%d, threshold=%.2f)\\n\", \n               num_points, threshold);\n        return 1;\n    }\n    \n    printf(\"QT Clustering Benchmark\\n\");\n    printf(\"Number of points: %d\\n\", num_points);\n    printf(\"Distance threshold: %.2f\\n\", threshold);\n    printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n    \n    // Generate synthetic data\n    std::vector<Point> points(num_points);\n    generateSyntheticData(points, num_points);\n    \n    // Perform QT clustering\n    auto cluster_start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    \n    const std::vector<Cluster> clusters = qtClustering(points, threshold);\n    \n    auto cluster_end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    auto cluster_time = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(\n        cluster_end - cluster_start);\n    \n    printf(\"Clustering time: %ld ms\\n\", cluster_time.count());\n    printf(\"Clusters found: %zu\\n\", clusters.size());\n    \n    // Calculate statistics and printf(\"Performance: %.1f clusters/s, %.1f points/s\\n\", \n           clusters_per_sec, points_per_sec);\n    \n    // Print results for external validation\n    if (printResults) {\n        // the original sequential algorithm.\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cfloat>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include            fprintf(stderr, \"CUDA error %s at %s:%d: %s\\n\", #call, __FILE__,    \\\n                    __LINE__, cudaGetErrorString(err__));                       \\\n            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);                                       \\\n        }                                                                        \\\n    } while (0)\n\n// Structure to represent a point in 2D space\nstruct Point {\n    double x, y;\n};\n\n// Structure to represent a cluster\nstruct Cluster {\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    int seed_point;\n};\n\n// Generate synthetic 2D point data in clusters\nvoid generateSyntheticData(std::vector<Point>& points, const int N, unsigned int seed = 42) {\n    auto frand = [&seed]() mutable { return rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX); };\n\n    const double min_dim = std::min(MAX_WIDTH, MAX_HEIGHT);\n    int count = 0;\n\n    while (count < N) {\n        // Create group_cnt points within a circle of radius R\n        // around center point (cntr_x, cntr_y)\n        const double cntr_x = frand() * MAX_WIDTH;\n        const double cntr_y = frand() * MAX_HEIGHT;\n        const double R = frand() * min_dim / 2.0;\n        int group_cnt = static_cast<int>(frand() * (N / 30.0));\n\n        // Make sure we don't make more points than we need\n        if (group_cnt > (N - count)) {\n            group_cnt = N - count;\n        }\n\n        while (group_cnt > 0) {\n            const double sign = (frand() < 0.5) ? -1.0 : 1.0;\n            const double r = frand() * R;\n            const double dx = (2.0 * frand() - 1.0) * r;\n            const double dy = std::sqrt(r * r - dx * dx) * sign;\n            const double x = cntr_x + dx;\n            const double y = cntr_y + dy;\n\n            if (x < 0 || x > MAX_WIDTH || y < 0 || y > MAX_HEIGHT) {\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            points[count] = {x, y};\n            count++;\n            group_cnt--;\n        }\n in seedList,\n// one CUDA block per seed. Uses the running-maximum-distance formulation:\n// runMax[i] tracks the maximum distance from point i to every point already\n// added to the cluster, so the next point to add is simply the unclustered\n// point with the smallest runMax[i] that still satisfies runMax[i] < threshold\n// (ties broken by smallest point index, matching the sequential scan order\n// of the original algorithm).\n__global__ void growClustersKernel(const double* __restrict__ dist,\n                                    const unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered,\n                                    const int* __restrict__ seedList,\n                                    int numSeeds,\n                                    int N,\n                                    double threshold,\n                                    double* __restrict__ runningMaxScratch,\n                                    unsigned char* __restrict__ inClusterScratch,\n                                    int* __restrict__ cardOut,\n                                    unsigned char* __restrict__ membershipOut) {\n    const int b = blockIdx.x;\n    if (b >= numSeeds) return;\n\n    const int seed = seedList[b];\n    double* runMax = runningMaxScratch + static_cast<size_t>(b) * N;\n    unsigned char* inClus = inClusterScratch + static_cast<size_t>(b) * N;\n    const double* distSeedRow = dist + static_cast<size_t>(seed) * N;\n\n    for (int i = threadIdx.x; an algorithm that builds clusters\n// by starting with a seed point and iteratively adding the closest point\n// that maintains the cluster's diameter below a threshold.\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <limits>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nstatic const double MAX_WIDTH = 20.0;\nstatic const double MAX_HEIGHT = 20.0;\n\n// Structure to represent a point in 2D space\nstruct Point {\n    double x, y;\n};\n\n// Structure to represent a cluster\nstruct Cluster {\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    int seed_point;\n};\n\n// Generate synthetic 2D point data in clusters\nvoid generateSyntheticData(std::vector<Point>& points, const int N, unsigned int seed = 42) {\n    auto frand = [&seed]() mutable { return rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX); };\n    \n    const double min_dim = std::min(MAX_WIDTH, MAX_HEIGHT);\n    int count = 0;\n    \n    while (count < N) {\n        // Create group_cnt points within a circle of radius R\n        // around center point (cntr_x, cntr_y)\n        const double cntr_x = frand() * MAX_WIDTH;\n        const double cntr_y = frand() * MAX_HEIGHT;\n        const double R = frand() * min_dim / 2.0;\n        int group_cnt = static_cast<int>(frand() * (N / 30.0));\n        \n        // Make sure we don't make more points than we need\n        if (group_cnt > (N - count)) {\n            group_cnt = N - count;\n        }\n        \n        while (group_cnt > 0) {\n            const double sign = (frand() < 0.5) ? -1.0 : 1.0;\n            const double r = frand() * R;\n            const double dx = (2.0 * frand() - 1.0) * r;\n            const double dy = std::sqrt(r * r - dx * dx) * sign;\n            const double x = cntr_x + dx;\n            const double y = cntr_y + dy;\n            \n            if (x < 0 || x > MAX_WIDTH || y < 0 || y > MAX_HEIGHT) {\n                continue;\n            }\n            \n            points[count] = {x, y};\n            count++;\n            group_cnt--;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Calculate Euclidean distance between two points\ninline double distance(const Point& p1, const Point& p2) {\n    double dx = p1.x - p2.x;\n    double dy = p1.y - p2.y;\n    return std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n}\n\n// Find the closest double min_dim = std::min(MAX_WIDTH, MAX_HEIGHT);\n    int count = 0;\n\n    while (count < N) {\n        // Create group_cnt points within a circle of radius R\n        // around center point (cntr_x, cntr_y)\n        const double cntr_x = frand() * MAX_WIDTH;\n        const double cntr_y = frand() * MAX_HEIGHT;\n        const double R = frand() * min_dim / 2.0;\n        int group_cnt =  auto frand = [&seed]() mutable { return rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX); };\n\n    const double min_dim = std::min(MAX_WIDTH, MAX_HEIGHT);\n    int count = 0;\n\n    while (count < N) {\n        // Create group_cnt points within a circle of radius R\n        // around center point (cntr_x, cntr_y)\n        const double cntr_x = frand() * MAX_WIDTH;\n        const double cntr_y = frand() * MAX_HEIGHT;\n        const double R = frand() * min_dim / 2.0;\n        int group_cnt = static_cast<int>(frand() * (N / 30.0));\n\n        // Make sure we don't make more points than we }\n}\n\n// CUDA kernel: grow a candidate QT cluster for every seed point in seedList,\n// one CUDA block per seed. <chrono>\n#include <cfloat>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <limits>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include <mpi.h>\n#include <omp.h>\n#include                                                                  \\\n    } while (0)\n\n// Structure to represent a point in 2D space\nstruct Point {\n    double x, y;\n};\n\n// Structure to represent a cluster\nstruct Cluster {\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    int seed_point;\n};\n\n// Generate synthetic 2D point data in clusters\nvoid generateSyntheticData(std::vector<Point>& points, const int N, unsigned int seed = 42) {\n    auto frand = [&seed]() mutable { return rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX); };\n\n    const double min_dim = std::min(MAX_WIDTH, MAX_HEIGHT);\n    int count = 0;\n\n    while (count < N) {\n        // Create group_cnt points within a circle of radius R\n        // around center point (cntr_x, cntr_y)\n        const double cntr_x = frand() * MAX_WIDTH;\n        const double cntr_y = frand() * MAX_HEIGHT;\n        const double R = frand() * min_dim / 2.0;\n        int group_cnt = static_cast<int>(frand() * (N / 30.0));\n\n        // Make sure we don't make more points than we need\n        if (group_cnt > (N - count)) {\n            group_cnt = N - count;\n        }\n\n        while (group_cnt > 0) {\n            const double sign = (frand() < 0.5) ? -1.0 : 1.0;\n            const double r = frand() * R;\n            const double dx = (2.0 * frand() - 1.0) * r;\n            const double dy = std::sqrt(r * r - dx * dx) * sign;\n            const double x = cntr_x + dx;\n            const double y = cntr_y + dy;\n\n            if (x < 0 || x > MAX_WIDTH || y < 0 || y > MAX_HEIGHT) {\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            points[count] = {x, y};\n            count++;\n            group_cnt--;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Calculate Euclidean distance between two points (host-side, used for validation)\ninline double distance(const Point& p1, const Point& p2) {\n    double dx = p1.x - p2.x;\n    double dy = p1.y - p2.y;\n    return std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n}\n\n// Compute the [begin, end) range of a contiguous, balanced split of `total`\n// items into `parts` parts, for part index `idx`.\nstatic void computeRange(int total, int parts, int idx, int* begin, int* end) {\n    const int base = total / parts;\n    const int rem = total % parts;\n    *begin = idx * base + std::min(idx, rem);\n    *end = *begin + base + (idx < rem ? 1 : 0);\n}\n\n// CUDA kernel: compute the full pairwise Euclidean distance matrix.\n__global__ void computeDistanceMatrixKernel(const Point* pts, double* dist, int N) {\n    const int i = blockIdx.y * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y;\n    const int j = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    if (i < N && j < N) {\n        const double dx = pts[i].x - pts[j].x;\n        const double dy = pts[i].y - pts[j].y;\n        dist[static_cast<size_t>(i) * N + j] = std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n    }\n}\n\n// CUDA kernel: grow a candidate QT cluster for every seed point in seedList,\n// one CUDA block per seed. Uses the running-maximum-distance formulation:\n// runMax[i] tracks the maximum distance from point i to every point already\n// added to the cluster, so the next point to add is simply the unclustered\n// point with the smallest runMax[i] that still satisfies runMax[i] < threshold\n// (ties broken by smallest point index, matching the sequential scan order\n// of the original algorithm).\n__global__ void growClustersKernel(const double* __restrict__ dist,\n                                    const unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered,\n                                    const int* __restrict__ seedList,\n                                    int numSeeds,\n                                    int N,\n                                    double threshold,\n                                    double* __restrict__ runningMaxScratch,\n                                    int* __restrict__ cardOut,\n                                    unsigned char* __restrict__ membershipOut) {\n    const int b = blockIdx.x;\n    if (b >= numSeeds) return;\n\n    const int seed = seedList[b];\n    double* runMax = runningMaxScratch + static_cast<size_t>(b) * N;\n    unsigned char* inClus = membershipOut + static_cast<size_t>(b) * N;\n    const double* distSeedRow = dist + static_cast<size_t>(seed) * N;\n\n    for (int i = threadIdx.x; i < N; i += blockDim.x) {\n        inClus[i] = 0;\n        runMax[i] = distSeedRow[i];\n    }\n\n    extern __shared__ double smem[];\n    double* sMinVal = smem;\n    int* sMinIdx = reinterpret_cast<int*>(sMinVal + blockDim.x);\n\n    __shared__ int sCount;\n    if (threadIdx.x == 0) {\n        inClus[seed] = 1;\n        sCount = 1;\n    }\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    while (sCount < N) {\n        double localMin = DBL_MAX;\n        int localIdx = -1;\n        for (int i = threadIdx.x; i < N; i += blockDim.x) {\n            if (!inClus[i] && !clustered[i] && runMax[i] < threshold) {\n                if (runMax[i] < localMin) {\n                    localMin = runMax[i];\n                    localIdx = i;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        sMinVal[threadIdx.x] = localMin;\n        sMinIdx[threadIdx.x] = localIdx;\n        __syncthreads();\n\n        for (int s = blockDim.x / 2; s > 0; s >>= 1) {\n            if (threadIdx.x < s) {\n                const double otherVal = sMinVal[threadIdx.x + s];\n                const int otherIdx = sMinIdx[threadIdx.x + s];\n                const double curVal = sMinVal[threadIdx.x];\n                const int curIdx = sMinIdx[threadIdx.x];\n                if (otherIdx >= 0 &&\n                    (curIdx < 0 || otherVal < curVal ||\n                     (otherVal == curVal && otherIdx < curIdx))) {\n                    sMinVal[threadIdx.x] = otherVal;\n                    sMinIdx[threadIdx.x] = otherIdx;\n                }\n            }\n            __syncthreads();\n        }\n\n        const int winner = sMinIdx[0];\n        if (winner < 0) break;\n\n        if (threadIdx.x == 0) {\n            inClus[winner] = 1;\n            sCount++;\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n\n        const double* distWinnerRow = dist + static_cast<size_t>(winner) * N;\n        for (int i = threadIdx.x; i < N; i += blockDim.x) {\n            if (!inClus[i]) {\n                const double dv = distWinnerRow[i];\n                if (dv > runMax[i]) runMax[i] = dv;\n            }\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n\n    if (threadIdx.x == 0) cardOut[b] = sCount;\n}\n\n// Per-GPU persistent device buffers.\nstruct GpuContext {\n    int device = -1;\n    Point* d_points = nullptr;\n    double* d_dist = nullptr;\n    unsigned char* d_clustered = nullptr;\n    int* d_seedList = nullptr;\n    int* d_cardOut = nullptr;\n    double* d_runningMax = nullptr;\n    unsigned char* d_membershipOut = nullptr;\n};\n\n// Validation: check that clusters satisfy the QT clustering properties\nbool validateClusters(const std::vector<Cluster>& clusters,\n                     const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                     const double threshold) {\n    bool valid = true;\n\n    printf(\"Validating clusters:\\n\");\n\n    // Check each cluster\n    for (size_t c = 0; i < m; ++i) {\n            for (int j = i + 1; j < m; ++j) {\n                const double dist = distance(points[cluster.members[i]],\n                                           points[cluster.members[j]]);\n                max_diameter = std::max(max_diameter, dist);\n            }\n        }\n\n        if (c < 10) { // Print first 10 clusters\n            printf(\"  Cluster %zu: size=%zu, seed=%d, diameter=%.4f\\n\",\n                   c, cluster.members.size(), cluster.seed_point, max_diameter);\n        }\n\n        // Validate diameter is within threshold\n        if (max_diameter > threshold * 1.001) { // Allow small numerical error\n            printf(\"ERROR: Cluster %zu has diameter %.4f > threshold %.4f\\n\",\n                   c, max_diameter, threshold);\n            valid = false;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Check for duplicate memberships\n    std::vector<int> membership(points.size(), -1);\n    for (size_t c = 0; i < membership.size(); ++i) {\n        if (membership[i] >= 0) clustered_count++;\n    }\n\n    printf(\"Total points: %zu, Clustered: %d, Unclustered: %zu\\n\",\n           points.size(), clustered_count, points.size() - clustered_count);\n\n    return valid;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Number of points (default: 1000)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -t <float>   Distance threshold for clustering (default: 2.0)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    MPI_Init(&argc, &argv);\n    int mpiRank = 0, mpiSize = 1;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &mpiRank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &mpiSize);\n\n    int num_points = 1000;\n    double threshold = 2.0;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < chunkSize; ++i) {\n                seedChunk[i] = unclustered_indices[rankBegin + devBegin + i];\n            }\n\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(ctx.d_clustered, clusteredU8.data(), sizeof(unsigned char) * N,\n                                   cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(ctx.d_seedList, seedChunk.data(), sizeof(int) * chunkSize,\n                                   cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n\n            growClustersKernel<<<chunkSize, THREADS_PER_BLOCK, sharedBytes>>>(\n                ctx.d_dist, ctx.d_clustered, ctx.d_seedList, chunkSize, N, threshold,\n                ctx.d_runningMax, ctx.d_membershipOut, ctx.d_cardOut);\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n\n            std::vector<int> cardHost(chunkSize);\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(cardHost.data(), ctx.d_cardOut, sizeof(int) * chunkSize,\n                                   cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n\n            int bestPos = -1, bestCard = -1, bestSeed = -1;\n            for (int i = 0; d < deviceCount; ++d) {\n            if (devBestCard[d] < 0) continue;\n            if (devBestCard[d] > rankBestCard ||\n                (devBestCard[d] == rankBestCard && devBestSeed[d] < rankBestSeed)) {\n                rankBestCard = devBestCard[d];\n                rankBestSeed = devBestSeed[d];\n                rankBestDev = d;\n            }\n        }\n\n        struct BestInfo { int card; int seed; int rank; };\n        BestInfo local{rankBestCard, rankBestSeed, mpiRank};\n        std::vector<BestInfo> allBest(mpiSize);\n        MPI_Allgather(&local, 3, MPI_INT, allBest.data(), 3, MPI_INT, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n        int winCard = -1, winSeed = -1, winRank = -1;\n        for (const auto& b : allBest) {\n            if (b.card <= 0) continue;\n            if (b.card > winCard || (b.card == winCard && b.seed < winSeed)) {\n                winCard = b.card;\n                winSeed = b.seed;\n                winRank = b.rank;\n            }\n        }\n\n        if (winCard <= 0) break; // No more clusters can be formed\n\n        std::vector<unsigned char> membership(N);\n        if (mpiRank == winRank) {\n            membership = devBestMembership[rankBestDev];\n        }\n        MPI_Bcast(membership.data(), N, MPI_UNSIGNED_CHAR, winRank, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n        Cluster cluster;\n        cluster.seed_point = winSeed;\n        cluster.members.reserve(winCard);\n        for (int i = 0; };\n\n    const double min_dim = std::min(MAX_WIDTH, MAX_HEIGHT);\n    int count = 0;\n\n    while (count < N) {\n        const double cntr_x = frand() * MAX_WIDTH;\n        const double cntr_y = frand() * MAX_HEIGHT;\n        const double R = frand() * min_dim / 2.0;\n        int group_cnt = static_cast<int>(frand() * (N / 30.0));\n\n        if (group_cnt > (N - count)) {\n            group_cnt = N - count;\n        }\n\n        while (group_cnt > 0) {\n            const double sign = (frand() < 0.5) ? -1.0 : 1.0;\n            const double r = frand() * R;\n            const double dx = (2.0 * frand() - 1.0) * r;\n            const double dy = std::sqrt(r * r - dx * dx) * sign;\n            const double x = cntr_x + dx;\n            const double y = cntr_y + dy;\n\n            if (x < 0 || x > MAX_WIDTH || y < 0 || y > MAX_HEIGHT) {\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            points[count] = {x, y};\n            count++;\n            group_cnt--;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\ninline double distance(const Point& p1, const Point& p2) {\n    double dx = p1.x - p2.x;\n    double dy = p1.y - p2.y;\n    return std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n}\n\nint findClosestPoint(const std::vector<int>& cluster_members,\n                     const std::vector<bool>& clustered,\n                     const std::vector<bool>& in_cluster,\n                     const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                     const double threshold,\n                     const int point_count) {\n    int closest_point = -1;\n    double min_diameter = std::numeric_limits<double>::max();\n\n    for (int candidate = 0; candidate < point_count; ++candidate) {\n        if (clustered[candidate] || in_cluster[candidate]) continue;\n\n        double max_dist = 0.0;\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < cluster_members.size(); ++i) {\n            const int member = cluster_members[i];\n            const double dist = distance(points[candidate], points[member]);\n            max_dist = std::max(max_dist, dist);\n        }\n\n        if (max_dist < threshold && max_dist < min_diameter) {\n            min_diameter = max_dist;\n            closest_point = candidate;\n        }\n    }\n\n    return closest_point;\n}\n\nint generateCandidateCluster(const int seed_point,\n                              const std::vector<bool>& clustered,\n                              const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                              const double threshold,\n                              const int point_count,\n                              std::vector<int>* cluster_members = nullptr) {\n    std::vector<bool> in_cluster(point_count, false);\n    std::vector<int> members;\n\n    in_cluster[seed_point] = true;\n    members.push_back(seed_point);\n\n    while (static_cast<int>(members.size()) < point_count) {\n        const int closest = findClosestPoint(members, clustered, in_cluster, points,\n                                             threshold, point_count);\n\n        if (closest < 0) break;\n\n        in_cluster[closest] = true;\n        members.push_back(closest);\n    }\n\n    if (cluster_members) {\n        *cluster_members = members;\n    }\n\n    return static_cast<int>(members.size());\n}\n\nstd::vector<Cluster> qtClustering(const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                                  const double threshold) {\n    const int N = static_cast<int>(points.size());\n    std::vector<bool> clustered(N, false);\n    std::vector<int> unclustered_indices;\n    std::vector<Cluster> clusters;\n\n    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        unclustered_indices.push_back(i);\n    }\n\n    while (!unclustered_indices.empty()) {\n        int max_cardinality = -1;\n        int best_seed = -1;\n        std::vector<int> best_cluster_members;\n\n        for (size_t i = 0; };\n\n    const double min_dim = std::min(MAX_WIDTH, MAX_HEIGHT);\n    int count = 0;\n\n    while (count < N) {\n        const double cntr_x = frand() * MAX_WIDTH;\n        const double cntr_y = frand() * MAX_HEIGHT;\n        const double R = frand() * min_dim / 2.0;\n        int group_cnt = static_cast<int>(frand() * (N / 30.0));\n\n        if (group_cnt > (N - count)) {\n            group_cnt = N - count;\n        }\n\n        while (group_cnt > 0) {\n            const double sign = (frand() < 0.5) ? -1.0 : 1.0;\n            const double r = frand() * R;\n            const double dx = (2.0 * frand() - 1.0) * r;\n            const double dy = std::sqrt(r * r - dx * dx) * sign;\n            const double x = cntr_x + dx;\n            const double y = cntr_y + dy;\n\n            if (x < 0 || x > MAX_WIDTH || y < 0 || y > MAX_HEIGHT) {\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            points[count] = {x, y};\n            count++;\n            group_cnt--;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\ninline double distance(const Point& p1, const Point& p2) {\n    double dx = p1.x - p2.x;\n    double dy = p1.y - p2.y;\n    return std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n}\n\nint findClosestPoint(const std::vector<int>& cluster_members,\n                     const std::vector<bool>& clustered,\n                     const std::vector<bool>& in_cluster,\n                     const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                     const double threshold,\n                     const int point_count) {\n    int closest_point = -1;\n    double min_diameter = std::numeric_limits<double>::max();\n\n    for (int candidate = 0; ++i) {\n            const int member = cluster_members[i];\n            const double dist = distance(points[candidate], points[member]);\n            max_dist = std::max(max_dist, dist);\n        }\n\n        if (max_dist < threshold && max_dist < min_diameter) {\n            min_diameter = max_dist;\n            closest_point = candidate;\n        }\n    }\n\n    return closest_point;\n}\n\nint generateCandidateCluster(const int seed_point,\n                              const std::vector<bool>& clustered,\n                              const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                              const double threshold,\n                              const int point_count,\n                              std::vector<int>* cluster_members = nullptr) {\n    std::vector<bool> in_cluster(point_count, false);\n    std::vector<int> members;\n\n    in_cluster[seed_point] = true;\n    members.push_back(seed_point);\n\n    while (static_cast<int>(members.size()) < point_count) {\n        const int closest = findClosestPoint(members, clustered, in_cluster, points,\n                                             threshold, point_count);\n\n        if (closest < 0) break;\n\n        in_cluster[closest] = true;\n        members.push_back(closest);\n    }\n\n    if (cluster_members) {\n        *cluster_members = members;\n    }\n\n    return static_cast<int>(members.size());\n}\n\nstd::vector<Cluster> qtClustering(const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                                  const double threshold) {\n    const int N = static_cast<int>(points.size());\n    std::vector<bool> clustered(N, false);\n    std::vector<int> unclustered_indices;\n    std::vector<Cluster> clusters;\n\n    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        unclustered_indices.push_back(i);\n    }\n\n    while (!unclustered_indices.empty()) {\n        int max_cardinality = -1;\n        int best_seed = -1;\n        std::vector<int> best_cluster_members;\n\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < unclustered_indices.size(); ++i) {\n            const int seed = unclustered_indices[i];\n            if (clustered[seed]) continue;\n\n            std::vector<int> candidate_members;\n            const int cardinality = generateCandidateCluster(seed, clustered, points,\n                                                       threshold, N,\n                                                       &candidate_members);\n\n            if (cardinality > max_cardinality) {\n                max_cardinality = cardinality;\n                best_seed = seed;\n                best_cluster_members = candidate_members;\n            }\n        }\n\n        if (best_seed >= 0 && max_cardinality > 0) {\n            Cluster cluster;\n            cluster.seed_point = best_seed;\n            cluster.members = best_cluster_members;\n            clusters.push_back(cluster);\n\n            for (size_t i = 0; i < best_cluster_members.size(); ++i) {\n                clustered[best_cluster_members[i]] = true;\n            }\n\n            unclustered_indices.erase(\n                std::remove_if(unclustered_indices.begin(), unclustered_indices.end(),\n                              [&clustered](int idx) { return clustered[idx]; }),\n                unclustered_indices.end()\n            );\n        } else {\n            break;\n        }\n    }\n\n    return clusters;\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    int num_points = 1000;\n    double threshold = 2.0;\n\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            num_points = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-t\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            threshold = atof(argv[++i]);\n        }\n    }\n\n    std::vector<Point> points(num_points);\n    generateSyntheticData(points, num_points);\n\n    const std::vector<Cluster> clusters = qtClustering(points, threshold);\n\n    std::vector<double> membershipData;\n    membershipData.reserve(num_points);\n    std::vector<int> membership(num_points, -1);\n    for (size_t c = 0; {"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_015So31ngjac8w6u9YPbaPz7","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t// QT Clustering Benchmark - Hybrid MPI + OpenMP + CUDA Version\n2\t//\n3\t// QT (Quality Threshold) clustering is an algorithm that builds clusters\n4\t// by starting with a seed point and iteratively adding the closest point\n5\t// that maintains the cluster's diameter below a threshold.\n6\t//\n7\t// Parallelization strategy:\n8\t//  - MPI distributes the candidate seed points of each clustering round\n9\t//    across ranks (e.g. across nodes of a cluster).\n10\t//  - OpenMP distributes each rank's share of seed points across the GPUs\n11\t//    that are locally visible to that rank.\n12\t//  - CUDA grows every candidate cluster (one CUDA block per seed point) in\n13\t//    parallel on the GPU, using the classic \"running maximum distance\"\n14\t//    formulation of QT clustering so that the result is bit-identical to\n15\t//    the original sequential algorithm.\n16\t\n17\t#include <algorithm>\n18\t#include <chrono>\n19\t#include <cfloat>\n20\t#include <cmath>\n21\t#include <cstdio>\n22\t#include <cstdlib>\n23\t#include <cstring>\n24\t#include <limits>\n25\t#include <vector>\n26\t\n27\t#include <mpi.h>\n28\t#include <omp.h>\n29\t#include <cuda_runtime.h>\n30\t\n31\t#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n32\t\n33\tstatic const double MAX_WIDTH = 20.0;\n34\tstatic const double MAX_HEIGHT = 20.0;\n35\tstatic const int THREADS_PER_BLOCK = 256;\n36\t\n37\t#define CUDA_CHECK(call)                                                        \\\n38\t    do {                                                                        \\\n39\t        cudaError_t err__ = (call);                                             \\\n40\t        if (err__ != cudaSuccess) {                                             \\\n41\t            fprintf(stderr, \"CUDA error %s at %s:%d: %s\\n\", #call, __FILE__,    \\\n42\t                    __LINE__, cudaGetErrorString(err__));                       \\\n43\t            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);                                       \\\n44\t        }                                                                        \\\n45\t    } while (0)\n46\t\n47\t// Structure to represent a point in 2D space\n48\tstruct Point {\n49\t    double x, y;\n50\t};"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"4cec52ca-7c6d-430b-b0b8-3fb2e5563019","uuid":"7b7935d4-6a0d-4b83-a20f-4155e67aaa33","timestamp":"2026-09-05T03:51:02.309Z","tool_use_result":{"type":"text","file":{"filePath":"/home/llmtest/evals/20260901-162328/qtclustering_claude-sonnet-5-cc-medium_hybrid_r2/qtclustering/qtclustering.cpp","content":"// QT Clustering Benchmark - Hybrid MPI + OpenMP + CUDA Version\n//\n// QT (Quality Threshold) clustering is an algorithm that builds clusters\n// by starting with a seed point and iteratively adding the closest point\n// that maintains the cluster's diameter below a threshold.\n//\n// Parallelization strategy:\n//  - MPI distributes the candidate seed points of each clustering round\n//    across ranks (e.g. across nodes of a cluster).\n//  - OpenMP distributes each rank's share of seed points across the GPUs\n//    that are locally visible to that rank.\n//  - CUDA grows every candidate cluster (one CUDA block per seed point) in\n//    parallel on the GPU, using the classic \"running maximum distance\"\n//    formulation of QT clustering so that the result is bit-identical to\n//    the original sequential algorithm.\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cfloat>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <limits>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include <mpi.h>\n#include <omp.h>\n#include <cuda_runtime.h>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nstatic const double MAX_WIDTH = 20.0;\nstatic const double MAX_HEIGHT = 20.0;\nstatic const int THREADS_PER_BLOCK = 256;\n\n#define CUDA_CHECK(call)                                                        \\\n    do {                                                                        \\\n        cudaError_t err__ = (call);                                             \\\n        if (err__ != cudaSuccess) {                                             \\\n            fprintf(stderr, \"CUDA error %s at %s:%d: %s\\n\", #call, __FILE__,    \\\n                    __LINE__, cudaGetErrorString(err__));                       \\\n            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);                                       \\\n        }                                                                        \\\n    } while (0)\n\n// Structure to represent a point in 2D space\nstruct Point {\n    double x, y;\n};","numLines":50,"startLine":1,"totalLines":597}}}

QT Clustering Benchmark - Hybrid MPI + OpenMP + CUDA Version\n//\n// QT (Quality Threshold) clustering is an algorithm that builds clusters\n// by starting with a seed point and iteratively adding the closest point\n// that maintains the cluster's diameter below a threshold.\n//\n// Parallelization strategy:\n//  - MPI distributes the candidate seed points of each clustering round\n//    across ranks (e.g. across nodes of a cluster).\n//  - OpenMP distributes each rank's share of seed points across the GPUs\n//    that are locally visible to that rank.\n//  - CUDA grows every candidate cluster (one CUDA block per seed point) in\n//    parallel on the GPU, using the classic \"running maximum distance\"\n//    formulation of QT clustering so that the result is bit-identical to\n//    the original sequential algorithm.\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cfloat>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <limits>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include <mpi.h>\n#include <omp.h>\n#include <cuda_runtime.h>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nstatic const double MAX_WIDTH = 20.0;\nstatic const double MAX_HEIGHT = 20.0;\nstatic const int THREADS_PER_BLOCK = 256;\n\n#define CUDA_CHECK(call)                                                        \\\n    do {                                                                        \\\n        cudaError_t err__ = (call);                                             \\\n        if (err__ != cudaSuccess) {                                             \\\n            fprintf(stderr, \"CUDA error %s at %s:%d: %s\\n\", #call, __FILE__,    \\\n                    __LINE__, cudaGetErrorString(err__));                       \\\n            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);                                       \\\n        }                                                                        \\\n    } while (0)\n\n// Structure to represent a point in 2D space\nstruct Point {\n    double x, y;\n};\n\n// Structure to represent a cluster\nstruct Cluster {\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    int seed_point;\n};\n\n// Generate synthetic 2D point data in clusters\nvoid generateSyntheticData(std::vector<Point>& points, const int N, unsigned int seed = 42) {\n    auto frand = [&seed]() mutable { return rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX); };\n\n    const double min_dim = std::min(MAX_WIDTH, MAX_HEIGHT);\n    int count = 0;\n\n    while (count < N) {\n        // Create group_cnt points within a circle of radius R\n        // around center point (cntr_x, cntr_y)\n        const double cntr_x = frand() * MAX_WIDTH;\n        const double cntr_y = frand() * MAX_HEIGHT;\n        const double R = frand() * min_dim / 2.0;\n        int group_cnt = static_cast<int>(frand() * (N / 30.0));\n\n        // Make sure we don't make more points than we need\n        if (group_cnt > (N - count)) {\n            group_cnt = N - count;\n        }\n\n        while (group_cnt > 0) {\n            const double sign = (frand() < 0.5) ? -1.0 : 1.0;\n            const double r = frand() * R;\n            const double dx = (2.0 * frand() - 1.0) * r;\n            const double dy = std::sqrt(r * r - dx * dx) * sign;\n            const double x = cntr_x + dx;\n            const double y = cntr_y + dy;\n\n            if (x < 0 || x > MAX_WIDTH || y < 0 || y > MAX_HEIGHT) {\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            points[count] = {x, y};\n            count++;\n            group_cnt--;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Calculate Euclidean distance between two points (host-side, used for validation)\ninline double distance(const Point& p1, const Point& p2) {\n    double dx = p1.x - p2.x;\n    double dy = p1.y - p2.y;\n    return std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n}\n\n// Compute the [begin, end) range of a contiguous, balanced split of `total`\n// items into `parts` parts, for part index `idx`.\nstatic void computeRange(int total, int parts, int idx, int* begin, int* end) {\n    const int base = total / parts;\n    const int rem = total % parts;\n    *begin = idx * base + std::min(idx, rem);\n    *end = *begin + base + (idx < rem ? 1 : 0);\n}\n\n// CUDA kernel: compute the full pairwise Euclidean distance matrix.\n__global__ void computeDistanceMatrixKernel(const Point* pts, double* dist, int N) {\n    const int i = blockIdx.y * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y;\n    const int j = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    if (i < N && j < N) {\n        const double dx = pts[i].x - pts[j].x;\n        const double dy = pts[i].y - pts[j].y;\n        dist[static_cast<size_t>(i) * N + j] = std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n    }\n}\n\n// CUDA kernel: grow a candidate QT cluster for every seed point in seedList,\n// one CUDA block per seed. Uses the running-maximum-distance formulation:\n// runMax[i] tracks the maximum distance from point i to every point already\n// added to the cluster, so the next point to add is simply the unclustered\n// point with the smallest runMax[i] that still satisfies runMax[i] < threshold\n// (ties broken by smallest point index, matching the sequential scan order\n// of the original algorithm).\n__global__ void growClustersKernel(const double* __restrict__ dist,\n                                    const unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered,\n                                    const int* __restrict__ seedList,\n                                    int numSeeds,\n                                    int N,\n                                    double threshold,\n                                    double* __restrict__ runningMaxScratch,\n                                    int* __restrict__ cardOut,\n                                    unsigned char* __restrict__ membershipOut) {\n    const int b = blockIdx.x;\n    if (b >= numSeeds) return;\n\n    const int seed = seedList[b];\n    double* runMax = runningMaxScratch + static_cast<size_t>(b) * N;\n    unsigned char* inClus = membershipOut + static_cast<size_t>(b) * N;\n    const double* distSeedRow = dist + static_cast<size_t>(seed) * N;\n\n    for (int i = threadIdx.x; i < N; i += blockDim.x) {\n        inClus[i] = 0;\n        runMax[i] = distSeedRow[i];\n    }\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    extern __shared__ double smem[];\n    double* sMinVal = smem;\n    int* sMinIdx = reinterpret_cast<int*>(sMinVal + blockDim.x);\n\n    __shared__ int sCount;\n    if (threadIdx.x == 0) {\n        inClus[seed] = 1;\n        sCount = 1;\n    }\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    while (sCount < N) {\n        double localMin = DBL_MAX;\n        int localIdx = -1;\n        for (int i = threadIdx.x; i < N; i += blockDim.x) {\n            if (!inClus[i] && !clustered[i] && runMax[i] < threshold) {\n                if (runMax[i] < localMin) {\n                    localMin = runMax[i];\n                    localIdx = i;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        sMinVal[threadIdx.x] = localMin;\n        sMinIdx[threadIdx.x] = localIdx;\n        __syncthreads();\n\n        for (int s = blockDim.x / 2; s > 0; s >>= 1) {\n            if (threadIdx.x < s) {\n                const double otherVal = sMinVal[threadIdx.x + s];\n                const int otherIdx = sMinIdx[threadIdx.x + s];\n                const double curVal = sMinVal[threadIdx.x];\n                const int curIdx = sMinIdx[threadIdx.x];\n                if (otherIdx >= 0 &&\n                    (curIdx < 0 || otherVal < curVal ||\n                     (otherVal == curVal && otherIdx < curIdx))) {\n                    sMinVal[threadIdx.x] = otherVal;\n                    sMinIdx[threadIdx.x] = otherIdx;\n                }\n            }\n            __syncthreads();\n        }\n\n        const int winner = sMinIdx[0];\n        if (winner < 0) break;\n\n        if (threadIdx.x == 0) {\n            inClus[winner] = 1;\n            sCount++;\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n\n        const double* distWinnerRow = dist + static_cast<size_t>(winner) * N;\n        for (int i = threadIdx.x; i < N; i += blockDim.x) {\n            if (!inClus[i]) {\n                const double dv = distWinnerRow[i];\n                if (dv > runMax[i]) runMax[i] = dv;\n            }\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n\n    if (threadIdx.x == 0) cardOut[b] = sCount;\n}\n\n// Per-GPU persistent device buffers.\nstruct GpuContext {\n    int device = -1;\n    Point* d_points = nullptr;\n    double* d_dist = nullptr;\n    unsigned char* d_clustered = nullptr;\n    int* d_seedList = nullptr;\n    int* d_cardOut = nullptr;\n    double* d_runningMax = nullptr;\n    unsigned char* d_membershipOut = nullptr;\n};\n\n// Validation: check that clusters satisfy the QT clustering properties\nbool validateClusters(const std::vector<Cluster>& clusters,\n                     const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                     const double threshold) {\n    bool valid = true;\n\n    printf(\"Validating clusters:\\n\");\n\n    // Check each cluster\n    for (size_t c = 0; c < clusters.size(); ++c) {\n        const auto& cluster = clusters[c];\n        double max_diameter = 0.0;\n\n        // Check diameter (max distance between any two points)\n        const int m = static_cast<int>(cluster.members.size());\n        #pragma omp parallel for reduction(max : max_diameter) schedule(static)\n        for (int i = 0; i < m; ++i) {\n            for (int j = i + 1; j < m; ++j) {\n                const double dist = distance(points[cluster.members[i]],\n                                           points[cluster.members[j]]);\n                max_diameter = std::max(max_diameter, dist);\n            }\n        }\n\n        if (c < 10) { // Print first 10 clusters\n            printf(\"  Cluster %zu: size=%zu, seed=%d, diameter=%.4f\\n\",\n                   c, cluster.members.size(), cluster.seed_point, max_diameter);\n        }\n\n        // Validate diameter is within threshold\n        if (max_diameter > threshold * 1.001) { // Allow small numerical error\n            printf(\"ERROR: Cluster %zu has diameter %.4f > threshold %.4f\\n\",\n                   c, max_diameter, threshold);\n            valid = false;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Check for duplicate memberships\n    std::vector<int> membership(points.size(), -1);\n    for (size_t c = 0; c < clusters.size(); ++c) {\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < clusters[c].members.size(); ++i) {\n            const int member = clusters[c].members[i];\n            if (membership[member] >= 0) {\n                printf(\"ERROR: Point %d appears in multiple clusters (%d and %zu)\\n\",\n                       member, membership[member], c);\n                valid = false;\n            }\n            membership[member] = static_cast<int>(c);\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Count clustered points\n    int clustered_count = 0;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < membership.size(); ++i) {\n        if (membership[i] >= 0) clustered_count++;\n    }\n\n    printf(\"Total points: %zu, Clustered: %d, Unclustered: %zu\\n\",\n           points.size(), clustered_count, points.size() - clustered_count);\n\n    return valid;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Number of points (default: 1000)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -t <float>   Distance threshold for clustering (default: 2.0)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    MPI_Init(&argc, &argv);\n    int mpiRank = 0, mpiSize = 1;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &mpiRank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &mpiSize);\n\n    int num_points = 1000;\n    double threshold = 2.0;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            num_points = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-t\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            threshold = atof(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            if (mpiRank == 0) printUsage(argv[0]);\n            MPI_Finalize();\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            if (mpiRank == 0) {\n                printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n                printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            MPI_Finalize();\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    if (num_points <= 0 || threshold <= 0.0) {\n        if (mpiRank == 0) {\n            printf(\"Error: Invalid parameters (num_points=%d, threshold=%.2f)\\n\",\n                   num_points, threshold);\n        }\n        MPI_Finalize();\n        return 1;\n    }\n\n    if (mpiRank == 0) {\n        printf(\"QT Clustering Benchmark\\n\");\n        printf(\"Number of points: %d\\n\", num_points);\n        printf(\"Distance threshold: %.2f\\n\", threshold);\n        printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n        printf(\"MPI ranks: %d\\n\", mpiSize);\n    }\n\n    // Generate synthetic data (deterministic; identical on every rank)\n    const int N = num_points;\n    std::vector<Point> points(N);\n    generateSyntheticData(points, N);\n\n    int deviceCount = 0;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceCount(&deviceCount));\n    if (deviceCount <= 0) {\n        fprintf(stderr, \"No CUDA devices visible to rank %d\\n\", mpiRank);\n        MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);\n    }\n\n    std::vector<GpuContext> gpuCtx(deviceCount);\n    const size_t sharedBytes = THREADS_PER_BLOCK * (sizeof(double) + sizeof(int));\n\n    #pragma omp parallel for num_threads(deviceCount) schedule(static)\n    for (int d = 0; d < deviceCount; ++d) {\n        GpuContext& ctx = gpuCtx[d];\n        ctx.device = d;\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(d));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&ctx.d_points, sizeof(Point) * N));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&ctx.d_dist, sizeof(double) * static_cast<size_t>(N) * N));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&ctx.d_clustered, sizeof(unsigned char) * N));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&ctx.d_seedList, sizeof(int) * N));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&ctx.d_cardOut, sizeof(int) * N));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&ctx.d_runningMax, sizeof(double) * static_cast<size_t>(N) * N));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&ctx.d_membershipOut, sizeof(unsigned char) * static_cast<size_t>(N) * N));\n\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(ctx.d_points, points.data(), sizeof(Point) * N, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n\n        dim3 block2d(16, 16);\n        dim3 grid2d((N + block2d.x - 1) / block2d.x, (N + block2d.y - 1) / block2d.y);\n        computeDistanceMatrixKernel<<<grid2d, block2d>>>(ctx.d_points, ctx.d_dist, N);\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());\n    }\n\n    // Main clustering loop\n    auto cluster_start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n\n    std::vector<unsigned char> clusteredU8(N, 0);\n    std::vector<int> unclustered_indices(N);\n    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) unclustered_indices[i] = i;\n\n    std::vector<Cluster> clusters;\n\n    while (!unclustered_indices.empty()) {\n        const int totalUnclustered = static_cast<int>(unclustered_indices.size());\n\n        int rankBegin, rankEnd;\n        computeRange(totalUnclustered, mpiSize, mpiRank, &rankBegin, &rankEnd);\n        const int rankChunkSize = rankEnd - rankBegin;\n\n        std::vector<int> devBestCard(deviceCount, -1);\n        std::vector<int> devBestSeed(deviceCount, -1);\n        std::vector<std::vector<unsigned char>> devBestMembership(deviceCount);\n\n        #pragma omp parallel for num_threads(deviceCount) schedule(static)\n        for (int d = 0; d < deviceCount; ++d) {\n            int devBegin, devEnd;\n            computeRange(rankChunkSize, deviceCount, d, &devBegin, &devEnd);\n            const int chunkSize = devEnd - devBegin;\n            if (chunkSize <= 0) continue;\n\n            GpuContext& ctx = gpuCtx[d];\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(d));\n\n            std::vector<int> seedChunk(chunkSize);\n            for (int i = 0; i < chunkSize; ++i) {\n                seedChunk[i] = unclustered_indices[rankBegin + devBegin + i];\n            }\n\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(ctx.d_clustered, clusteredU8.data(), sizeof(unsigned char) * N,\n                                   cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(ctx.d_seedList, seedChunk.data(), sizeof(int) * chunkSize,\n                                   cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n\n            growClustersKernel<<<chunkSize, THREADS_PER_BLOCK, sharedBytes>>>(\n                ctx.d_dist, ctx.d_clustered, ctx.d_seedList, chunkSize, N, threshold,\n                ctx.d_runningMax, ctx.d_cardOut, ctx.d_membershipOut);\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n\n            std::vector<int> cardHost(chunkSize);\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(cardHost.data(), ctx.d_cardOut, sizeof(int) * chunkSize,\n                                   cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n\n            int bestPos = -1, bestCard = -1, bestSeed = -1;\n            for (int i = 0; i < chunkSize; ++i) {\n                const int seedId = seedChunk[i];\n                if (cardHost[i] > bestCard ||\n                    (cardHost[i] == bestCard && bestPos >= 0 && seedId < bestSeed)) {\n                    bestCard = cardHost[i];\n                    bestSeed = seedId;\n                    bestPos = i;\n                }\n            }\n\n            if (bestPos >= 0 && bestCard > 0) {\n                devBestCard[d] = bestCard;\n                devBestSeed[d] = bestSeed;\n                devBestMembership[d].resize(N);\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(devBestMembership[d].data(),\n                                       ctx.d_membershipOut + static_cast<size_t>(bestPos) * N,\n                                       sizeof(unsigned char) * N, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n            }\n        }\n\n        int rankBestCard = -1, rankBestSeed = -1, rankBestDev = -1;\n        for (int d = 0; d < deviceCount; ++d) {\n            if (devBestCard[d] < 0) continue;\n            if (devBestCard[d] > rankBestCard ||\n                (devBestCard[d] == rankBestCard && devBestSeed[d] < rankBestSeed)) {\n                rankBestCard = devBestCard[d];\n                rankBestSeed = devBestSeed[d];\n                rankBestDev = d;\n            }\n        }\n\n        struct BestInfo { int card; int seed; int rank; };\n        BestInfo local{rankBestCard, rankBestSeed, mpiRank};\n        std::vector<BestInfo> allBest(mpiSize);\n        MPI_Allgather(&local, 3, MPI_INT, allBest.data(), 3, MPI_INT, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n        int winCard = -1, winSeed = -1, winRank = -1;\n        for (const auto& b : allBest) {\n            if (b.card <= 0) continue;\n            if (b.card > winCard || (b.card == winCard && b.seed < winSeed)) {\n                winCard = b.card;\n                winSeed = b.seed;\n                winRank = b.rank;\n            }\n        }\n\n        if (winCard <= 0) break; // No more clusters can be formed\n\n        std::vector<unsigned char> membership(N);\n        if (mpiRank == winRank) {\n            membership = devBestMembership[rankBestDev];\n        }\n        MPI_Bcast(membership.data(), N, MPI_UNSIGNED_CHAR, winRank, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n        Cluster cluster;\n        cluster.seed_point = winSeed;\n        cluster.members.reserve(winCard);\n        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n            if (membership[i]) {\n                cluster.members.push_back(i);\n                clusteredU8[i] = 1;\n            }\n        }\n        clusters.push_back(std::move(cluster));\n\n        unclustered_indices.erase(\n            std::remove_if(unclustered_indices.begin(), unclustered_indices.end(),\n                          [&clusteredU8](int idx) { return clusteredU8[idx] != 0; }),\n            unclustered_indices.end()\n        );\n    }\n\n    auto cluster_end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    auto cluster_time = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(\n        cluster_end - cluster_start);\n\n    #pragma omp parallel for num_threads(deviceCount) schedule(static)\n    for (int d = 0; d < deviceCount; ++d) {\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(d));\n        GpuContext& ctx = gpuCtx[d];\n        cudaFree(ctx.d_points);\n        cudaFree(ctx.d_dist);\n        cudaFree(ctx.d_clustered);\n        cudaFree(ctx.d_seedList);\n        cudaFree(ctx.d_cardOut);\n        cudaFree(ctx.d_runningMax);\n        cudaFree(ctx.d_membershipOut);\n    }\n\n    if (mpiRank == 0) {\n        printf(\"Clustering time: %ld ms\\n\", cluster_time.count());\n        printf(\"Clusters found: %zu\\n\", clusters.size());\n\n        // Calculate statistics and performance metrics\n        int total_clustered = 0;\n        int max_cluster_size = 0;\n\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < clusters.size(); ++i) {\n            const int size = static_cast<int>(clusters[i].members.size());\n            total_clustered += size;\n            max_cluster_size = std::max(max_cluster_size, size);\n        }\n\n        const double avg_cluster_size = clusters.empty() ? 0.0 :\n            static_cast<double>(total_clustered) / clusters.size();\n\n        printf(\"Points clustered: %d / %d (%.1f%%)\\n\",\n               total_clustered, num_points,\n               100.0 * total_clustered / num_points);\n        printf(\"Average cluster size: %.2f\\n\", avg_cluster_size);\n        printf(\"Maximum cluster size: %d\\n\", max_cluster_size);\n\n        // Performance metrics\n        const double time_sec = cluster_time.count() / 1000.0;\n        const double clusters_per_sec = clusters.size() / time_sec;\n        const double points_per_sec = num_points / time_sec;\n        printf(\"Performance: %.1f clusters/s, %.1f points/s\\n\",\n               clusters_per_sec, points_per_sec);\n\n        // Print results for external validation\n        if (printResults) {\n            // Serialize cluster membership for hashing\n            std::vector<double> membershipData;\n            membershipData.reserve(num_points);\n            std::vector<int> membership(num_points, -1);\n            for (size_t c = 0;
